Dot is OPTIONAL. Three-character category codes (I10, E11, F10, N18) are real codes and are stored dotless. Requiring the dot rejected 1,953 real codes (regression, 2026-07-25). Validated 2026-07-27 vs 100,035 concept_codes: 0 FN. Position 1 is a LETTER: narrowed 2026-08-12 from ^\w{3}(\.\w{1,4})?$, which accepted 16,100 of 17,564 ICD9CM concept_codes (250.00, V45.81, 042) plus bare digits and _-leading junk. Validated vs 100,035 ICD10CM concept_codes in Athena 20260625: 0 FN. Positions 2-3 stay \w deliberately - FY2026 introduced QA0, a LETTER in position 2, and the permissive tail is why this row needed no edit for it. Position 2 narrowed 2026-08-12 from \w to (digit | the literal QA): measured over the FY2026 tabular corpus, \w there admitted 426 additional ordinary word-tokens (ABC, ALL, ARE, Age, Air, AST, AML) while removing ZERO cross-vocabulary false positives - ICD9CM acceptance is 1,357 either way, because V## and E### are already letter+digit. QA is enumerated because FY2026's QA0 is the only ICD-10-CM category ever to carry a letter in position 2 (FY2025: zero). ONE false negative, excluded deliberately: NOD.X ('No diagnosis', concept_id 35209512) is invalid_reason='D', retired 2009-12-31.

WHO ICD-10, distinct from ICD10CM. Three branches: codes (A20, A30.8, M23.07), SubChapter ranges (A15-A19), and Chapter roman numerals (I..XXII). Validated 2026-07-27 vs 16,638 concept_codes: 0 FN on real codes; excludes 351 placeholder rows named Invalid ICD10 Concept, do not use whose concept_code is just the concept_id (e.g. 45532996).
Dotless form of ICD10. Upper bound 7 mirrors ICD10CM.DOTLESS for headroom; WHO ICD-10 only reaches 5 dotless today. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN on real codes (same 351 placeholder exclusions).

Full codes are 7 characters; 1-6 character codes are real hierarchy/partial-code concepts. Deliberately NOT tightened: the ICD-10-PCS spec excludes the letters I and O from every axis, so a caller needing to discriminate PCS from ICD-10-CM may add that itself - usage-specific strictness belongs in the CALLER. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 197,098 concept_codes: 0 FN on real codes; excludes MTHU000001-3 (UMLS GEM mapping-table nodes).

OI hybrid procedure vocabulary (csc-171): CPT4 + HCPCS unioned and deduped, 30,357 concepts, because the digit/letter split is administrative not clinical. DELIBERATELY permissive - it admits both digit-leading (CPT) and letter-leading (HCPCS) codes, which is the entire point. Validated 2026-07-27: matches 25,848 of the 25,850 five-character codes, 0 FN on billable codes. The 2 five-char non-matches are V-CPT and V-SRC (UMLS source markers, not procedure codes - confirmed excluded); also excludes 3,787 CPT4 Hierarchy, 549 modifiers (see .WITHMODIFIERS), 106 HCPCS Class, 50 Visit.
CPT4_HCPCS plus 2-character modifiers, mirroring the CPT4/HCPCS rows. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN over billable codes + all 549 modifier concepts.
Validated 2026-07-27 vs the 549 modifier concept_codes in CPT4_HCPCS (385 HCPCS Modifier + 164 CPT4 Modifier): 0 FN.

CLAIMS DEFAULT (vfm-k2n): the 11-digit billing form, labeler-product-package — what appears on a claim. NDC.COMPLETE carries the full vocabulary. NB ^\d{11}$ alone rejects 338,303 real 9-digit concept_codes, which is CORRECT for this row's target and a bug for NDC.COMPLETE's. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN vs the 964,647 eleven-digit concept_codes (25 of which are alphanumeric - use NDC.ALPHANUM).

The FULL vocabulary, not just the claims form: 9-digit is FDA labeler+product without the package segment (337,085 class '9-digit NDC' + 1,218 Device). Validated 2026-07-27 vs all 1,302,950 concept_codes: 0 FN on all-numeric codes; the 39 alphanumeric ones need NDC.ALPHANUM. See vfm-8l5.

NUMERIC ONLY (vfm-27p): every one of the 464,018 UUID-shaped SNOMED concept_codes is INVALID (invalid_reason U=367,198 / D=96,820; zero valid), so a numeric-only default rejects nothing valid. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN vs all VALID SNOMED concept_codes. Retired concepts need SNOMED.WITHRETIRED.

Includes the UUID form used by RETIRED/withdrawn SNOMED concepts (464,018 rows, all invalid). Named for what distinguishes them - retirement - NOT the UK drug extension: the largest class is Physical Object (194,791), not drugs. Caveat: this accepts ANY UUID as a SNOMED code. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN vs all 1,093,147 concept_codes. See vfm-27p.

CMS Diagnosis-Related Group, always 3 zero-padded digits. 1,362 rows but only 871 distinct concept_codes - the same code recurs across DRG versions, so a lookup on (code, vocabulary_id) is NOT unique here. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN.
Papers and claims extracts frequently drop the leading zeros (DRG 1 for 001), the same trap as .DOTLESS. Validated 2026-07-27 vs all 1,362 DRG concept_codes: 0 FN.

Stock OHDSI ICD-O-3 (SEER Site/Histology). Codes are COMPOSITE histology-topography pairs (8000/0-C00.0) and either half may be the literal string NULL (8000/0-NULL). Also carries bare histology (8000/0), bare topography (C00.0), 3-digit groups (800) and ranges (801-804), plus one reversed pair (C57.9-8746/3). The leading/trailing \s* accommodates a known upstream defect: concept 36402927 has concept_code 9342/3 with a TRAILING SPACE, duplicating 44498515. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 64,471 concept_codes: 0 FN.

OI supplemental morphology-only split (histology/behavior). NOTE the id is ICD03 with a DIGIT ZERO, unlike stock ICDO3 with a LETTER O - they are different vocabularies. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 1,367 concept_codes: 0 FN.
